scope: Predefined source-adjudicated labels for selected admitted reviews in original Kotlin fixtures, including ordinary observations with no established weakness. Observation dismissals do not certify unspecified inputs, callbacks or configuration. Not whole-application recall, deployment exposure, or full language parity. Excluded lookalikes are covered separately by native tests.
